title: The bootstrap messages for enrolling through an identity provider
spec: Bootstrap request tag 39 RedeemExternal { device_name (1 to MAX_DEVICE_NAME), csr (1 to MAX_CSR) } and tag 40 ConfirmExternal { code (1 to MAX_AUTH_CODE_BYTES), verifier (MIN_VERIFIER_LEN to MAX_VERIFIER_LEN), redirect_uri (1 to MAX_REDIRECT_BYTES), each printable ASCII }; response tag 167 ExternalStart { issuer, client_id, authorization_endpoint, nonce (a 32-byte base64url token) }. Encoder and decoder enforce the same limits (FieldLength), Truncated and TrailingBytes as for the other bootstrap messages. Debug hides the code, the verifier and the nonce. The sign-in tags (34 to 38, 163 to 166) stay BadKind for the bootstrap decoders, and the new tags are refused by the ordinary request decoder and the sign-in decoders.
